title.raw: 卷四百六十八 列傳第二百二十七 宦者三 李祥 陳衍 馮世寧 李繼和 高居簡 程昉 蘇利涉 雷允恭 閻文應 任守忠 童貫方臘 梁師成 楊戩 Volume 468 Biographies 227: Eunuchs 3 - Li Xiang, Chen Yan, Feng Shining, Li Jihe, Gao Jujian, Cheng Fang, Su Lishe, Lei Yungong, Yan Wenying, Ren Shouzhong, Tongguan Fangla, Liang Shicheng, Yang Jian

sentences.zh: 宦者三

translations.literal: Eunuchs 3
translations.idiomatic: Eunuchs, Part Three

sentences.zh: ○李祥陳衍馮世寧李繼和高居簡程昉蘇利涉雷允恭閻文應任守忠童貫

translations.literal: ○ Li Xiang, Chen Yan, Feng Shining, Li Jihe, Gao Jujian, Cheng Fang, Su Lishe, Lei Yungong, Yan Wenying, Ren Shouzhong, Tong Guan
translations.idiomatic: ○ Li Xiang, Chen Yan, Feng Shining, Li Jihe, Gao Jujian, Cheng Fang, Su Lishe, Lei Yungong, Yan Wenying, Ren Shouzhong, and Tong Guan

sentences.zh: 〈（方臘附）〉

translations.literal: (Fang La appended) close appendix marker
translations.idiomatic: (Fang La appended.)

sentences.zh: 梁師成楊戩

translations.literal: Liang Shicheng, Yang Jian
translations.idiomatic: Liang Shicheng and Yang Jian

sentences.zh: 李祥，開封人。

translations.literal: Li Xiang, Kaifeng person.
translations.idiomatic: Li Xiang was a native of Kaifeng.

sentences.zh: 為入內黃門。

translations.literal: Was enter-inner Yellow Gate.
translations.idiomatic: He served as an Enter-the-Inner Yellow Gate eunuch.

sentences.zh: 資 驍銳，善騎射，用材武中選，授涇原儀渭同巡檢。

translations.literal: Endowment brave sharp, good ride shoot, by talent martial selected, conferred Jingyuan Yiwei same patrol inspector.
translations.idiomatic: Naturally bold and keen, skilled in riding and archery, he was chosen through the martial-talent selection and appointed joint patrol inspector of Jingyuan, Yi, and Wei.

sentences.zh: 從景思立於河、湟，以功遷內殿崇班，為河州駐泊兵馬都監。

translations.literal: Followed Jing Silizhi at He, Huang, by merit moved inner hall exalted class, was Hezhou garrisoned troops horse all supervisor.
translations.idiomatic: Following Jing Silizhi on the He and Huang frontiers, he was promoted for merit to Inner Hall Exalted Class and made overall supervisor of garrisoned troops at Hezhou.

sentences.zh: 從郭逵討交阯，駐富良江，賊兵大至，與涇原將姚兕 力戰，敗之。

translations.literal: Followed Guo Kui campaign Jiaozhi, garrisoned Fu Liang River, bandit troops greatly arrived, with Jingyuan general Yao Si force battled, defeated them.
translations.idiomatic: He accompanied Guo Kui in the campaign against Jiaozhi and was stationed on the Fu Liang River; when rebel forces came in great strength, he fought fiercely with the Jingyuan general Yao Si and routed them.

sentences.zh: 遷皇城使、鎮戎軍沿邊都巡檢使。

translations.literal: Moved Imperial City envoy, Zhenrong Army along-border all patrol inspector envoy.
translations.idiomatic: He was promoted to Imperial City Envoy and overall patrol inspector along the Zhenrong frontier.

sentences.zh: 從劉昌祚征靈武，議功加沂州團練使。

translations.literal: Followed Liu Changzuo campaign Lingwu, discussed merit add Yizhou regiment trainer envoy.
translations.idiomatic: He followed Liu Changzuo in the Lingwu campaign and, when merits were assessed, was slated for promotion to regiment trainer of Yizhou.

sentences.zh: 或言所部兵失亡多，降簡州刺史，權熙河蘭會路都監，總岷州兵。

translations.literal: Someone said his command troops lost perished many, demoted Jianzhou prefect, acting Xihé Lanhui circuit all supervisor, overall Minzhou troops.
translations.idiomatic: When someone reported heavy losses among his troops, he was demoted to prefect of Jianzhou and given acting authority as overall supervisor of the Xihé Lanhui circuit, commanding the forces of Minzhou.

sentences.zh: 夏人攻蘭 州，祥赴援，保險待變，數日，虜徹圍去。

translations.literal: Xi people attacked Lanzhou, Xiang went rescue, held defiles awaited change, several days, barbarians withdrew encirclement left.
translations.idiomatic: When the Tangut attacked Lanzhou, Xiang hurried to relieve the city, held strong positions and waited for developments; after several days the enemy lifted the siege and withdrew.

sentences.zh: 復團練使，進階州防禦使。

translations.literal: Restored regiment trainer envoy, advanced Jiezhou defense envoy.
translations.idiomatic: He was restored to regiment trainer and advanced to defense envoy of Jiezhou.

sentences.zh: 從種誼襲鬼章有功，升兵馬都鈐轄。

translations.literal: Followed Chong Yi raid Gui Zhang had merit, rose horse-all commander-in-chief.
translations.idiomatic: He followed Chong Yi in the successful raid on Gui Zhang and was promoted to overall commander of cavalry.

sentences.zh: 在熙河二十餘年，以宣慶使、內侍押班卒。

translations.literal: At Xihé twenty-odd years, by Xuanqing envoy, inner attendant escort class died.
translations.idiomatic: After more than twenty years on the Xihé frontier, he died holding the posts of Xuanqing Envoy and chief of the inner attendant escort class.

sentences.zh: 陳衍，開封人。

translations.literal: Chen Yan, Kaifeng person.
translations.idiomatic: Chen Yan was a native of Kaifeng.

sentences.zh: 以內侍給事殿庭，累官供備庫使。

translations.literal: By inner attendant attend palace court, accumulated office supply-prepare treasury envoy.
translations.idiomatic: As an inner attendant he served in the palace audience hall and rose through posts to Supply-Prepare Treasury Envoy.

sentences.zh: 梁惟簡薦諸宣仁聖烈皇后，主管高韓王宅，領禦藥院、內東門司。

translations.literal: Liang Weijian recommended to Xuanren Sacred Lie empress, supervised Gao-Han prince residence, led Imperial Pharmacy courtyard, inner east gate office.
translations.idiomatic: Recommended by Liang Weijian to Empress Xuanren the Sacred and Lie, he oversaw the residences of the Gao and Han princes and headed both the Imperial Pharmacy and the Inner East Gate Office.

sentences.zh: 宣仁山陵，為按行使。

translations.literal: Xuanren mountain tomb, was inspection envoy.
translations.idiomatic: At the construction of Empress Xuanren's mausoleum he served as inspection envoy.

sentences.zh: 俄以左藏庫使、文州刺史出為真定路都監。

translations.literal: Soon by left treasury envoy, Wenshan prefect went out as Zhending circuit all supervisor.
translations.idiomatic: Shortly thereafter he was sent out as overall supervisor of the Zhending circuit with the titles Left Treasury Envoy and prefect of Wenshan.

sentences.zh: 御史來之邵方力詆元祐政事，首言：“衍在垂簾日，怙寵驕肆，交結戚裏，進退大臣，力引所私，俾居耳目之地。”

translations.literal: Censor Lai Zhishao just then forcefully slandered Yuanyou government affairs, first said: “Yan at curtain-rule day, relied favor arrogant unrestrained, connected relatives by marriage, advance dismiss great ministers, force led his private men, made occupy ear-eye places.”
translations.idiomatic: The censor Lai Zhishao, then vigorously attacking Yuanyou policies, led off by saying: “During the regency Yan relied on imperial favor, grew arrogant, cultivated ties with the empress's kin, controlled the appointment and dismissal of chief ministers, and forced his own men into posts that kept the court under surveillance."

sentences.zh: 張商英亦論：“衍交通宰相，禦服為之賜珠；

translations.literal: Zhang Shangying also discussed: “Yan connected with chief minister, imperial robes for him bestowed pearls;
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Shangying added: “Yan cultivated the chief minister—imperial robes and pearls were bestowed for his sake;

sentences.zh: 結托詞臣，儲祥為之賜膳。”

translations.literal: connected entrusted literary ministers, stored auspiciousness for him bestowed meals.”
translations.idiomatic: he cultivated literary officials—auspicious meals at the Stored Felicity Hall were sent down for his sake.”

sentences.zh: 蓋指呂大防、蘇軾也。

translations.literal: This referred to Lü Dafang, Su Shi.
translations.idiomatic: This referred to Lü Dafang and Su Shi.

sentences.zh: 衍坐貶，監郴州酒稅務。

translations.literal: Yan sat demoted, supervised Chenzhou wine tax office.
translations.idiomatic: Yan was convicted and demoted to supervisor of the Chenzhou wine-tax office.

sentences.zh: 惟簡以援引，張士良、梁知新以黨附，皆得罪。

translations.literal: Weijian by drawing in, Zhang Shiliang, Liang Zhixin by faction attached, all offended.
translations.idiomatic: Weijian was punished for patronage; Zhang Shiliang and Liang Zhixin were punished for factional attachment.

sentences.zh: 已又編管白州，徙配朱崖。

translations.literal: Already again registered supervised Baizhou, moved assigned Zhuya.
translations.idiomatic: He was then placed under registered supervision at Baizhou and later transferred in exile to Zhuya.

sentences.zh: 章惇起獄，誣元祐諸老、大臣，雲結衍輩以謀廢立。

translations.literal: Zhang Dun raised case, slandered Yuanyou various elders, great ministers, saying joined Yan and company to plot depose establish.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Dun launched a prosecution, accusing the Yuanyou elders and senior ministers of plotting with Yan and his circle to depose and replace the emperor.

sentences.zh: 士良嚐與衍同在宣仁後閣，自郴州召之，使實其說。

translations.literal: Shiliang once with Yan together at Xuanren rear pavilion, from Chenzhou summoned him, made verify his statement.
translations.idiomatic: Shiliang, who had once served with Yan in Empress Xuanren's rear pavilion, was recalled from Chenzhou to corroborate the charge.

sentences.zh: 士良至，但言宣仁彌留之際，衍嚐可否二府事及用禦寶付 外而已。

translations.literal: Shiliang arrived, only said Xuanren final illness time, Yan once approved disapproved two offices affairs and used imperial seal bestowed outside only.
translations.idiomatic: When Shiliang arrived he testified only that during Empress Xuanren's final illness Yan had occasionally approved or rejected matters of the two councils and had once sent the imperial seal outside the palace—nothing more.

sentences.zh: 鍛煉無所得，安惇、蔡京乃奏衍疏隔兩宮，斥隨龍內侍十餘人於外，以剪除人主腹心羽翼，意在動搖，大逆不道。

translations.literal: Forging interrogation obtained nothing, An Dun, Cai Jing then memorialized Yan estranged separated two palaces, expelled follow-dragon inner attendants ten-odd men outside, to cut remove ruler belly heart wing feathers, intent in shake move, great rebellion not way.
translations.idiomatic: Unable to extract more by forced interrogation, An Dun and Cai Jing memorialized that Yan had estranged the Two Palaces, expelled more than ten inner attendants of the “follow-the-dragon” corps, and sought to cut away the sovereign's closest supporters with intent to shake the throne—capital treason.

sentences.zh: 乃詔處死，令廣西轉運使程節涖其刑。

translations.literal: Then edict put to death, ordered Guangxi transport commissioner Cheng Jie oversee his punishment.
translations.idiomatic: An edict ordered his execution, with Guangxi transport commissioner Cheng Jie sent to supervise the sentence.

sentences.zh: 馮世寧

translations.literal: Feng Shining
translations.idiomatic: Feng Shining

sentences.zh: 馮世寧，字靜之，以入內黃門累遷昭宣使、忠州團練使、入內押班。

translations.literal: Feng Shining, style Jingzhi, by enter-inner Yellow Gate accumulated moved Zhaoxuan envoy, Zhongzhou regiment trainer envoy, enter-inner escort class.
translations.idiomatic: Feng Shining, courtesy name Jingzhi, rose from Enter-the-Inner Yellow Gate through Zhaoxuan Envoy and regiment trainer of Zhongzhou to chief of the enter-inner escort class.

sentences.zh: 揚國公主寢疾，哲宗欲夜出問訊，世寧執言不可，帝雖微忤，卒為之改容。

translations.literal: Yangguo princess bed illness, Zhezong wished night go out inquire visit, Shining firmly spoke not permissible, emperor though slight offended, finally for him changed countenance.
translations.idiomatic: When Princess Yangguo lay gravely ill the Zhezong Emperor wished to go out at night to visit her; Shining firmly objected, and though the emperor was briefly displeased, he ultimately moderated his manner.

sentences.zh: 再遷景福殿使、明 州觀察使。

translations.literal: Again moved Jingfu Hall envoy, Mingzhou observation envoy.
translations.idiomatic: He was further promoted to Jingfu Hall Envoy and observation envoy of Mingzhou.

sentences.zh: 至副都知。

translations.literal: Reached associate chief eunuch.
translations.idiomatic: He rose to associate chief eunuch.

sentences.zh: 崇寧新官名，世寧首知入內內侍省事。

translations.literal: Chongning new office names, Shining first knew enter-inner inner attendant province affairs.
translations.idiomatic: Under the Chongning renaming of offices he became the first superintendent of the Enter-the-Inner Inner Attendant Province.

sentences.zh: 禁中夜火，使宿衛士撲滅之，既定，令自他途出，蓋不欲使知宮省曲折也。

translations.literal: Forbidden within night fire, sent night-guard soldiers extinguish it, already settled, ordered from other path exit, probably not wish make know palace province twists.
translations.idiomatic: When a night fire broke out in the palace he had the night guards extinguish it; once it was out he ordered them to leave by another route so they would not learn the palace's layout.

sentences.zh: 徽宗賞歎。

translations.literal: Huizong praised sighed.
translations.idiomatic: Huizong praised him warmly.

sentences.zh: 進感德軍留後。

translations.literal: Advanced Gandé Army acting governor.
translations.idiomatic: He was promoted to acting governor of the Gandé Army.

sentences.zh: 政和初，以內客省使、彰化軍留後致仕。

translations.literal: Zhenghe beginning, by inner guest province envoy, Zhanghua Army acting governor retired office.
translations.idiomatic: At the beginning of the Zhenghe era he retired with the titles Inner Guest Province Envoy and acting governor of the Zhanghua Army.

sentences.zh: 世寧出入禁闥六十年，循謹無過。

translations.literal: Shining exit enter forbidden gate sixty years, followed careful without fault.
translations.idiomatic: Shining had passed in and out of the forbidden precincts for sixty years, scrupulous and without reproach.

sentences.zh: 卒，年六十七，贈開府儀同三司。

translations.literal: Died, age sixty-seven, bestowed open-fu ceremony equal three offices.
translations.idiomatic: He died at sixty-seven and was posthumously granted the ceremonial rank of Open-fu, Equal to the Three Offices.

sentences.zh: 諡曰恭節。

translations.literal: Posthumous title said Respectful Integrity.
translations.idiomatic: His posthumous title was Respectful Integrity.

sentences.zh: 李繼和

translations.literal: Li Jihe
translations.idiomatic: Li Jihe

sentences.zh: 李繼和，開封人。

translations.literal: Li Jihe, Kaifeng person.
translations.idiomatic: Li Jihe was a native of Kaifeng.

sentences.zh: 以父任為內侍黃門。

translations.literal: By father's office was inner attendant Yellow Gate.
translations.idiomatic: Through his father's office he entered service as an inner-attendant Yellow Gate.

sentences.zh: 慶曆中，為河北西路承受。

translations.literal: Qingli middle, was Hebei West circuit receiver.
translations.idiomatic: During the Qingli era he served as receiver on the Hebei West circuit.

sentences.zh: 保州兵叛，塞城門距守，官軍重圍之，不得入。

translations.literal: Baozhou troops rebelled, blocked city gates resisted guard, government troops heavy encircled it, could not enter.
translations.idiomatic: When Baozhou troops mutinied they barred the gates and held the city while government forces encircled it but could not enter.

sentences.zh: 繼和獨上南關門，密呼所結內應者，諭以禍福。

translations.literal: Jihe alone ascended south pass gate, secretly called those he had won inside responders, instructed with disaster blessing.
translations.idiomatic: Jihe alone climbed the south pass gate, secretly summoned the insiders he had cultivated, and admonished them with the consequences of fortune and ruin.

sentences.zh: 眾言：“俟李昭亮至，即斬關自歸。”

translations.literal: Crowd said: “Await Li Zhaoliang arrive, then cut pass self return.”
translations.idiomatic: They replied: “When Li Zhaoliang arrives we will cut the pass and surrender.”

sentences.zh: 已而果然。

translations.literal: Already afterward indeed so.
translations.idiomatic: And so it proved.

sentences.zh: 賊平，遷兩秩。

translations.literal: Bandits pacified, moved two ranks.
translations.idiomatic: After the rebels were pacified he was promoted two ranks.

sentences.zh: 王則反貝州，為城下走馬承受。

translations.literal: Wang Ze rebelled Beizhou, was under-wall gallop horse receiver.
translations.idiomatic: When Wang Ze rebelled at Beizhou he served as galloping horse receiver beneath the walls.

sentences.zh: 沙苑闕馬，詔秦州置場以券市之，繼和領職不數月，得馬千數，而人不擾。

translations.literal: Shaxi lacked horses, edict Qinzhou establish field by certificate market them, Jihe led office not several months, obtained horses thousand-odd, yet people not disturbed.
translations.idiomatic: When the Shaxi pastures lacked horses the court ordered a Qinzhou market to buy them with certificates; Jihe took charge and within months procured more than a thousand horses without troubling the people.

sentences.zh: 舊制，內侍入仕三十年始得磨勘，至是，乃令以勞進官者無拘於年。

translations.literal: Old regulation, inner attendant enter office thirty years then could merit review, to this, then ordered by labor advance office ones without bound by years.
translations.idiomatic: By old rule inner attendants needed thirty years in service before merit review; now those promoted for merit were freed from the age limit.

sentences.zh: 環州弓箭手歲時給酒，州將不與，眾喧訴，亟闔府門不敢出，繼和步入眾中譬曉之曰：“汝曹為一杯酒，遂喪軀命乎！”

translations.literal: Huanzhou bowmen yearly time given wine, prefect not give, crowd clamor appealed, urgently shut prefecture gate dared not exit, Jihe walked into crowd admonish enlighten them saying: “You fellows for one cup wine, then lose body life!”
translations.idiomatic: At Huanzhou the bowmen's annual wine ration was withheld by the prefect; they clamored in protest and he shut the gate in fear. Jihe walked into the crowd and said: “Will you throw away your lives for a cup of wine?"

sentences.zh: 眾悟散去。

translations.literal: Crowd understood dispersed left.
translations.idiomatic: The crowd understood and dispersed.

sentences.zh: 事聞，擢帶禦器械。

translations.literal: Matter heard, promoted carry imperial arms.
translations.idiomatic: When the affair was reported he was promoted to Bearer of Imperial Arms.

sentences.zh: 累遷宣慶使、文州團練使、入內副都知，卒。

translations.literal: Accumulated moved Xuanqing envoy, Wenshan regiment trainer envoy, enter-inner associate chief eunuch, died.
translations.idiomatic: He rose through Xuanqing Envoy and regiment trainer of Wenshan to associate chief eunuch of the enter-inner corps and died in office.

sentences.zh: 子從善援例求贈官，神宗曰：“此弊事也！

translations.literal: Son Congshan by precedent sought bestowed office, Shenzong said: “This bad practice!
translations.idiomatic: His son Congshan sought a posthumous grant by precedent; Shenzong said: “This is a corrupt practice!

sentences.zh: 繼和無軍功，何必贈？”

translations.literal: Jihe without military merit, why must bestow?”
translations.idiomatic: Jihe had no military merit—why grant anything?

sentences.zh: 自是為定制雲。

translations.literal: From this became fixed regulation.
translations.idiomatic: From then on this became fixed regulation.

sentences.zh: 高居簡

translations.literal: Gao Jujian
translations.idiomatic: Gao Jujian

sentences.zh: 高居簡，字仲略，世本番禺人。

translations.literal: Gao Jujian, style Zhonglüe, generations originally Panyu people.
translations.idiomatic: Gao Jujian, courtesy name Zhonglüe, was by descent from Panyu.

sentences.zh: 以父任為入內黃門。

translations.literal: By father's office was enter-inner Yellow Gate.
translations.idiomatic: Through his father's office he became an Enter-the-Inner Yellow Gate eunuch.

sentences.zh: 護作溫成原廟奉神物，以精辦稱，超轉殿頭，領後苑事。

translations.literal: Protected construct Wencheng original temple offer spirit objects, by refined manage praised, leap turned hall head, led rear garden affairs.
translations.idiomatic: Overseeing the spirit objects for Wencheng's original temple, he won praise for meticulous management, was promoted leapfrog to hall head, and directed the rear imperial garden.

sentences.zh: 坐奉使梓夔路多占驛兵，降高品。

translations.literal: Sat mission Zi-Qi circuit many occupied relay soldiers, demoted high grade.
translations.idiomatic: He was demoted for requisitioning too many relay troops on a mission to the Zi-Qi circuit.

sentences.zh: 曆領龍圖、天章、寶文閣、內東門司，幹當禦藥院。

translations.literal: Successively led Dragon Diagram, Heavenly Chapter, Treasured Literature pavilions, inner east gate office, managed Imperial Pharmacy courtyard.
translations.idiomatic: He successively headed the Dragon Diagram, Heavenly Chapter, and Treasured Literature pavilions, the Inner East Gate Office, and the Imperial Pharmacy.

sentences.zh: 神宗即位，御史張唐英言其資性憸巧，善迎合取容。

translations.literal: Shenzong ascended throne, censor Zhang Tangying said his nature crafty clever, good ingratiate gain countenance.
translations.idiomatic: When Shenzong took the throne the censor Zhang Tangying said he was crafty and skilled at flattery.

sentences.zh: 中丞司馬光亦言其“久處近職，罪惡已多。

translations.literal: Vice censor-in-chief Sima Guang also said his “long dwelt near office, crimes already many.
translations.idiomatic: The vice censor-in-chief Sima Guang also said, “Having long held intimate posts, his offenses are many.

sentences.zh: 祖宗舊制，幹當禦藥院官至內殿崇班以上，即須出外。

translations.literal: Ancestors old regulation, manage Imperial Pharmacy office rank reaches inner hall exalted class and above, then must go outside.
translations.idiomatic: Ancestral regulation required those who managed the Imperial Pharmacy and reached Inner Hall Exalted Class or above to leave the inner service.

sentences.zh: 今陛下獨留 四人，中外以此竊議。

translations.literal: Now Your Majesty alone retains four men, inside outside by this privately discuss.
translations.idiomatic: Your Majesty alone keeps four men in such posts, and court and country whisper about it.

sentences.zh: 況居簡頃在先朝，依憑城社，物論切齒。

translations.literal: Moreover Jujian just then in former dynasty, relied leaning city altar, public opinion gnash teeth.
translations.idiomatic: Moreover Jujian in the previous reign leaned on powerful patrons, and public opinion gnashed its teeth.

sentences.zh: 及陛下繼統，乃復先自結納，使寵信之恩過於先帝。

translations.literal: When Your Majesty succeeded, then again first self connect accept, made favor trust grace surpass former emperor.
translations.idiomatic: When Your Majesty succeeded he again courted favor first, winning trust beyond what the late emperor gave.

sentences.zh: 願明治其罪，以解天下之惑”。

translations.literal: Wish enlighten govern his crime, to resolve under-heaven's doubt”.
translations.idiomatic: I beg that his crimes be clearly punished to remove the empire's doubts.”

sentences.zh: 於是罷為供備庫 使。

translations.literal: Thereupon dismissed as supply-prepare treasury envoy.
translations.idiomatic: He was therefore removed to Supply-Prepare Treasury Envoy.

sentences.zh: 稍遷帶禦器械，進內侍押班。

translations.literal: Shortly moved carry imperial arms, advanced inner attendant escort class.
translations.idiomatic: He was soon restored to Bearer of Imperial Arms and advanced to the inner attendant escort class.

sentences.zh: 以文思使領忠州刺史。

translations.literal: By Wensi envoy led Zhongzhou prefect.
translations.idiomatic: As Wensi Envoy he also held the prefecture of Zhongzhou.

sentences.zh: 卒，贈耀州觀察使。

translations.literal: Died, bestowed Yaozhou observation envoy.
translations.idiomatic: He died and was posthumously made observation envoy of Yaozhou.

translations.literal: Already afterward Renzong again regretted deposing Guo empress, had restore empress intent, Wenying greatly feared.
translations.idiomatic: Renzong later regretted deposing Empress Guo and thought of restoring her; Wenying was terrified.

sentences.zh: 會後有小疾，挾太醫診視數日，乃言後暴崩，實文應為之也。

translations.literal: Meeting empress had small illness, brought imperial physicians examine view several days, then said empress sudden collapse, actually Wenying did it.
translations.idiomatic: When the empress fell slightly ill he brought imperial physicians for days, then announced sudden death—it was Wenying's doing.

sentences.zh: 累至昭宣使、恩州團練使。

translations.literal: Accumulated to Zhaoxuan envoy, Enzhou regiment trainer envoy.
translations.idiomatic: He rose to Zhaoxuan Envoy and regiment trainer of Enzhou.

sentences.zh: 時諫官劾其罪，請並其子士良出之。

translations.literal: At time remonstrance officials impeached his crimes, requested together his son Shiliang expel them.
translations.idiomatic: Remonstrance officials impeached him and asked that his son Shiliang be expelled as well.

sentences.zh: 以文應領嘉州防禦使，為秦州鈐轄，改鄆州，士良罷禦藥院，為內殿崇班。

translations.literal: By Wenying led Jiazhou defense envoy, was Qinzhou commander, changed Yanzhou, Shiliang dismissed Imperial Pharmacy courtyard, was inner hall exalted class.
translations.idiomatic: Wenying was made defense envoy of Jiazhou and commander at Qinzhou, later Yanzhou; Shiliang left the Imperial Pharmacy for Inner Hall Exalted Class.

sentences.zh: 始楊、尚二美人之出宮也，左右引陳氏女入宮，父號陳子城，楊太后嚐許以為後，宋綬不可。

translations.literal: Beginning Yang, Shang two beauties' exit palace, left-right led Chen clan girl enter palace, father called Chen Zicheng, Yang empress dowager once promised make her empress, Song Shou not permissible.
translations.idiomatic: When the Yang and Shang beauties left the palace attendants introduced a Chen girl whose father was called Chen Zicheng; Empress Dowager Yang had promised to make her empress, but Song Shou objected.

sentences.zh: 王曾、呂夷簡、蔡齊相繼論諫。

translations.literal: Wang Zeng, Lü Yijian, Cai Qi successively discussed remonstrated.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Zeng, Lü Yijian, and Cai Qi remonstrated in turn.

sentences.zh: 陳氏女將進禦，士良聞之，遽見仁 宗。

translations.literal: Chen clan girl about to advance imperial audience, Shiliang heard it, hurried saw Renzong.
translations.idiomatic: As the Chen girl was to be presented, Shiliang heard of it and rushed to Renzong.

sentences.zh: 仁宗披百葉擇日，士良曰：“陛下閱此，豈非欲納陳氏女為後邪？”

translations.literal: Renzong spread hundred-leaf select day, Shiliang said: “Your Majesty read this, is it not wish take Chen clan girl as empress?”
translations.idiomatic: Renzong was reading the calendar of auspicious days; Shiliang said, “Your Majesty—is this not to take the Chen girl as empress?”

sentences.zh: 仁宗曰：“然。”

translations.literal: Renzong said: “So.”
translations.idiomatic: Renzong said, “It is.”

sentences.zh: 士良曰：“子城使，大臣家奴仆官名也，陛下納其女為後，無乃不可 乎！”

translations.literal: Shiliang said: “Zicheng envoy, great minister household slave servant official name, Your Majesty take her daughter as empress, probably not permissible!”
translations.idiomatic: Shiliang said, “Zicheng was a minister's household steward—how can Your Majesty make his daughter empress?”

sentences.zh: 仁宗遽命出之。

translations.literal: Renzong hurried ordered expel her.
translations.idiomatic: Renzong at once ordered her sent out.

sentences.zh: 文應後徙相州鈐轄。

translations.literal: Wenying later moved Xiangzhou commander.
translations.idiomatic: Wenying was later transferred as commander of Xiangzhou.

sentences.zh: 卒，贈邠州觀察使。

translations.literal: Died, bestowed Binzhou observation envoy.
translations.idiomatic: He died and was posthumously made observation envoy of Binzhou.

sentences.zh: 任守忠

translations.literal: Ren Shouzhong
translations.idiomatic: Ren Shouzhong

sentences.zh: 任守忠，字稷臣，蔭入內黃門，累轉西頭供奉官，領禦藥院，坐事廢。

translations.literal: Ren Shouzhong, style Jichen, yin enter-inner Yellow Gate, accumulated turned west head tribute offer official, led Imperial Pharmacy courtyard, sat affair dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: Ren Shouzhong, courtesy name Jichen, entered by yin privilege as Enter-the-Inner Yellow Gate, rose to west-head tribute envoy and head of the Imperial Pharmacy, and was dismissed for an offense.

sentences.zh: 久之，復故官， 稍遷上御藥供奉。

translations.literal: Long afterward, restored former office, shortly moved upper imperial medicine tribute offer.
translations.idiomatic: After long service he was restored and promoted to upper imperial-medicine tribute offer.

sentences.zh: 初，章獻後聽政，守忠與都知江德明等交通請謁，權寵過盛。

translations.literal: Beginning, Zhangxian empress listened government, Shouzhong with chief eunuch Jiang Deming and others connected requests audiences, power favor excessively flourishing.
translations.idiomatic: Under Empress Zhangxian's regency Shouzhong and chief eunuch Jiang Deming trafficked in access and grew overmighty.

sentences.zh: 仁宗親政，出為黃州都監，又謫監英州酒稅，稍遷潭州都監，徙合流鎮。

translations.literal: Renzong personally governed, went out as Huangzhou all supervisor, again demoted supervise Yingzhou wine tax, shortly moved Tanzhou all supervisor, moved Heliu town.
translations.idiomatic: When Renzong took rule Shouzhong was sent out as Huangzhou supervisor, demoted to Yingzhou wine tax, then Tanzhou supervisor, then Heliu town.

sentences.zh: 西鄙用兵， 又為秦鳳、涇原路駐泊都監，以功再遷東染院使、內侍押班。

translations.literal: Western border used troops, again was Qinfeng, Jingyuan circuit garrisoned all supervisor, by merit again moved east dye courtyard envoy, inner attendant escort class.
translations.idiomatic: In the western campaigns he was garrison supervisor on the Qinfeng and Jingyuan circuits and was twice promoted for merit to east dye courtyard envoy and inner attendant escort.

sentences.zh: 出為定州鈐轄，加內侍副都知。

translations.literal: Went out as Dingzhou commander, added inner attendant associate chief eunuch.
translations.idiomatic: He went out as commander of Dingzhou and was made associate chief eunuch.

sentences.zh: 累遷宣政使、洋州觀察使，為入內都知。

translations.literal: Accumulated moved Xuanzheng envoy, Yangzhou observation envoy, was enter-inner chief eunuch.
translations.idiomatic: He rose to Xuanzheng Envoy and observation envoy of Yangzhou and became chief eunuch of the enter-inner corps.

sentences.zh: 仁宗未有嗣，屬 意英宗，守忠居中建議，欲援立昏弱以徼大利。

translations.literal: Renzong had no heir and favored Yingzong; Shouzhong meddled, hoping to enthrone a weak ruler for great gain.
translations.idiomatic: Renzong had no heir and favored Yingzong; Shouzhong meddled, hoping to enthrone a weak ruler for great gain.

sentences.zh: 及英宗即位，拜宣慶使、安靜軍留後。

translations.literal: When Yingzong ascended throne, bestowed Xuanqing envoy, Anjing Army acting governor.
translations.idiomatic: When Yingzong ascended the throne he was made Xuanqing Envoy and acting governor of the Anjing Army.

sentences.zh: 守忠又語言誕妄，交亂兩宮。

translations.literal: Shouzhong again words absurd wild, crossed disturbed two palaces.
translations.idiomatic: Shouzhong again spoke wildly and disturbed the Two Palaces.

sentences.zh: 於是知諫院司馬光論守忠離間之罪，為國之大 賊，民之巨蠹，乞斬於都市。

translations.literal: Thereupon remonstrance court Sima Guang discussed Shouzhong estrange separate crime, as state's great bandit, people's huge pest, beg execute at capital market.
translations.idiomatic: Remonstrance official Sima Guang charged him with estranging the Two Palaces—the state's great traitor and the people's plague—and begged execution in the capital market.

sentences.zh: 英宗猶未行，宰相韓琦出空頭敕一道，參政歐陽修已簽，趙概難之，修曰：“第書之，韓公必自有說。”

translations.literal: Yingzong still not carried out, chief minister Han Qi produced blank-head edict one document, participating administrator Ouyang Xiu already signed, Zhao Gai difficult it, Xiu said: “Only write it, Duke Han surely has explanation.”
translations.idiomatic: Yingzong hesitated; Han Qi produced a blank edict already signed by Ouyang Xiu; Zhao Gai objected, and Xiu said, “Write it—Lord Han will explain.”

sentences.zh: 琦遂坐政事堂，立守忠庭下， 曰：“汝罪當死，貶保信軍節度副使、蘄州安置。”

translations.literal: Qi then sat Administration Hall, stood Shouzhong courtyard below, said: “Your crime ought die, demoted Baoxin Army military commissioner deputy envoy, Qizhou settled.”
translations.idiomatic: Qi sat in the Administration Hall, had Shouzhong stand below, and said, “Your crime deserves death; you are demoted to deputy military commissioner of Baoxin and settled at Qizhou.”

sentences.zh: 取空頭敕填與之，即日押行，琦意以為少緩則中變也。

translations.literal: Took blank-head edict filled gave him, same day escorted go, Qi intent thought if slightly slow then middle change.
translations.idiomatic: He filled the blank edict and sent him off the same day, fearing delay might bring reversal.

sentences.zh: 守忠久被寵幸，用事於中，人不敢言其過，及貶，中外快之。

translations.literal: Shouzhong long favored, wielded affairs in middle, people dared not speak his faults, when demoted, inside outside rejoiced.
translations.idiomatic: Long favored and ruling from within, none had dared speak against him; at his demotion court and country rejoiced.

sentences.zh: 久之，起為左武衛將軍，致仕，卒，年七十九。

translations.literal: Long afterward, raised as Left Martial Guard general, retired office, died, age seventy-nine.
translations.idiomatic: He was later restored as general of the Left Martial Guard, retired, and died at seventy-nine.

sentences.zh: 童貫，少出李憲之門。

translations.literal: Tong Guan, young exited Li Xian's gate.
translations.idiomatic: Tong Guan in youth came from Li Xian's household.

sentences.zh: 性巧媚，自給事宮掖，即善策人主微指，先事順承。

translations.literal: Nature clever ingratiating, from attend palace women's quarters, then good plan ruler subtle intent, beforehand affairs comply follow.
translations.idiomatic: Clever and ingratiating, serving in the palace quarters he read the ruler's subtle wishes and anticipated them.

sentences.zh: 微宗立，置明金局於杭，貫以供奉官主之，始與蔡京遊。

translations.literal: Huizong established, set Bright Gold bureau at Hang, Guan by tribute offer official headed it, first with Cai Jing associate.
translations.idiomatic: When Huizong ascended he placed the Bright Gold Bureau at Hangzhou with Guan as tribute envoy in charge, and Guan first befriended Cai Jing.

sentences.zh: 京進，貫力也。

translations.literal: Jing advanced, Guan's force.
translations.idiomatic: Jing's rise was Guan's doing.

sentences.zh: 京既相，讚策 取青唐，因言貫嚐十使陝右，審五路事宜與諸將之能否為最悉，力薦之。

translations.literal: Jing already chief minister, praised plan take Qingtang, thereby said Guan once ten times sent Shaan right, examined five circuits affairs with various generals' able not able as most thorough, force recommended him.
translations.idiomatic: Once Jing was chief minister he urged taking Qingtang, saying Guan had been sent ten times to the Shaanxi frontier, knew the five circuits and every general's capacity better than anyone, and strongly recommended him.

sentences.zh: 合兵十萬，命王厚專閫寄，而貫用李憲故事監其軍。

translations.literal: Combined troops hundred thousand, ordered Wang Hou sole military commission, yet Guan used Li Xian precedent supervise his army.
translations.idiomatic: A hundred thousand troops were assembled; Wang Hou held sole command while Guan, following Li Xian's precedent, supervised the army.

sentences.zh: 至湟川，適禁中火，帝下手劄，驛止貫 毋西兵。

translations.literal: Reached Huang River, just then forbidden within fire, emperor sent hand note, post station stop Guan not west troops.
translations.idiomatic: At the Huang River a palace fire broke out; the emperor sent a courier order forbidding Guan to advance west.

sentences.zh: 貫發視，遽納鞾中。

translations.literal: Guan opened viewed, hurriedly put in boot.
translations.idiomatic: Guan read it and thrust it into his boot.

sentences.zh: 厚問故，貫曰：“上趣成功耳。”

translations.literal: Hou asked reason, Guan said: “Above urges success only."
translations.idiomatic: When Hou asked why, Guan said, “The emperor wants success—that is all.”

sentences.zh: 師竟出，復四州。

translations.literal: close double-quotation mark; army ultimately went out, recovered four prefectures
translations.idiomatic: The army marched out anyway and recovered four prefectures.

sentences.zh: 擢景福殿使、襄州觀察使，內侍寄資轉兩使自茲始。

translations.literal: Promoted Jingfu Hall envoy, Xiangzhou observation envoy, inner attendant entrusted rank turned two envoys from this began.
translations.idiomatic: He was made Jingfu Hall Envoy and observation envoy of Xiangzhou—the first inner attendant to hold two envoy ranks on entrusted credentials.

sentences.zh: 未幾，為熙河蘭湟、秦鳳路經略安撫製置使，累遷武康軍節度使。

translations.literal: Not long, was Xihé Lantang, Qinfeng circuit frontier pacification commissioner, accumulated moved Wukang Army military commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: Soon he was frontier pacification commissioner of Xihé Lantang and Qinfeng and rose to military commissioner of the Wukang Army.

sentences.zh: 討溪哥臧征，復積石軍、洮州，加檢校司空。

translations.literal: Campaign Xige Zangzheng, recovered Jishi Army, Taozhou, added acting Sikong.
translations.idiomatic: Campaigning against Xige Zangzheng he recovered Jishi Army and Taozhou and was made acting Sikong.

sentences.zh: 頗恃功驕恣，選置將吏，皆捷取中旨，不復關朝廷，浸咈京意。

translations.literal: Quite relied merit arrogant unrestrained, selected placed generals officials, all quick take middle edicts, no longer pass court, gradually offended Jing intent.
translations.idiomatic: Proud of merit, he appointed officers by swift imperial word without court review and gradually alienated Jing.

sentences.zh: 除開府儀同三司，京曰：“使相豈應授宦官？”

translations.literal: Removed open-fu ceremony equal three offices, Jing said: “Envoy chief minister how ought confer eunuch?"
translations.idiomatic: When made Open-fu Equal to the Three Offices, Jing said, “Should a chief minister's rank go to a eunuch?”

sentences.zh: 不奉詔。

translations.literal: close double-quotation mark; not receive edict
translations.idiomatic: Guan did not accept the edict.

sentences.zh: 將秦、晉銳師深入河、隴，薄於蕭關古骨龍，謂可製夏人死命。

translations.literal: Will Qin, Jin sharp troops deep enter He, Long, approach Xia Pass ancient bone dragon, said can control Xi people life.
translations.idiomatic: He would lead Qin and Jin elite troops deep into He and Long toward Gugulong at Xia Pass, claiming to hold the Tangut's fate.

sentences.zh: 遣大將劉 法取朔方，法不可，貫逼之曰：“君在京師時，親授命於王所，自言必成功，今難之，何也？”

translations.literal: Sent great general Liu Fa take Shuofang, Fa not permissible, Guan forced him said: “You at capital time, personally received mandate at king place, self said must succeed, now difficult it, why?"
translations.idiomatic: He sent Liu Fa to take Shuofang; Fa refused; Guan pressed him: “In the capital you vowed success at the throne—why refuse now?”

sentences.zh: 法不得已出塞，遇伏而死。

translations.literal: close double-quotation mark; Fa had no choice but exit pass, met ambush and died
translations.idiomatic: Fa had to march out, met an ambush, and died.

sentences.zh: 法，西州名將，既死，諸軍恟懼。

translations.literal: Fa, Xizhou famous general, already died, various armies alarmed feared.
translations.idiomatic: Fa, a famed general of the western circuits, was dead and the armies panicked.

sentences.zh: 貫隱其 敗，以捷聞，百官入賀，皆切齒，然莫敢言。

translations.literal: Guan concealed his defeat, by victory reported, hundred officials enter congratulate, all gnash teeth, yet none dared speak.
translations.idiomatic: Guan hid the defeat and reported victory; officials congratulated while gnashing their teeth, yet none dared speak.

sentences.zh: 關右既困，夏人亦不能支，乃因遼人進誓表納款。

translations.literal: Pass right already distressed, Xi people also could not support, then through Liao people advance oath table submit allegiance.
translations.idiomatic: The northwest was exhausted and the Tangut could not hold out; they submitted an oath of allegiance through the Liao.

sentences.zh: 使至，授以誓詔，辭不取，貫強館伴使固與之，還及境，棄諸道上。

translations.literal: Envoy arrived, conferred oath edict, declined not take, Guan forced lodging companion envoy firmly give it, returned reaching border, abandoned on road.
translations.idiomatic: When the envoy came Guan forced the oath edict on him; at the border the envoy abandoned it on the road.

sentences.zh: 舊制，熟羌不授漢官，貫故引拔之，有至節度使者。

translations.literal: Old regulation, mature Qiang not confer Han offices, Guan therefore drew promote them, some reached military commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: By old rule mature Qiang were not given Han offices; Guan promoted them, some to military commissioner.

sentences.zh: 弓箭手失其分地而使守新疆，禁卒逃亡不死而得改隸他籍，軍政盡壞。

translations.literal: Bowmen lost their allotted lands yet made guard new frontier, forbidden soldiers fled death yet could change attach other registers, military government all ruined.
translations.idiomatic: Bowmen lost allotments yet guarded new frontiers; deserters escaped death by shifting registers—the army was ruined.

sentences.zh: 方臘者，睦州青溪人也。

translations.literal: Fang La, Muzhou Qingxi person.
translations.idiomatic: Fang La was a native of Qingxi in Muzhou.

sentences.zh: 世居縣堨村，托左道以惑眾。

translations.literal: Generations dwelt county embankment village, relied left way to delude crowd.
translations.idiomatic: His clan lived at the county embankment village and he used heterodox teachings to beguile the people.

sentences.zh: 初，唐永徽中，睦州女子陳碩真反，自稱文佳皇帝，故其地相傳有天子基、萬年樓，臘益得憑籍以自信。

translations.literal: Beginning, Tang Yonghui middle, Muzhou woman Chen Shuozhen rebelled, self called Wenkai emperor, therefore that land handed down has Son of Heaven foundation, Ten-Thousand-Year tower, La increasingly could rely on to self believe.
translations.idiomatic: In Tang Yonghui a Muzhou woman, Chen Shuozhen, had rebelled as the Wenkai Emperor; the region was said to hold a Son of Heaven's foundation and Ten-Thousand-Year Tower, which bolstered La's confidence.

sentences.zh: 縣境梓桐、幫源諸峒皆落山谷幽險處，民物繁夥，有漆楮、杉材之饒，富商巨賈多往來。

translations.literal: County border Zitong, Bangyuan various mountain strongholds all fall valley deep dangerous places, people goods numerous, had lacquer paper, cedar timber abundance, great merchants huge traders many come go.
translations.idiomatic: Zitong and Bangyuan gorges were populous, rich in lacquer, paper, and cedar; great merchants passed through.

sentences.zh: 時吳中困於朱勔花石之擾，比屋致怨，臘因民不忍，陰聚貧乏遊手之徒。

translations.literal: At time Wu middle distressed by Zhu Mian flower-stone harassment, every house brought resentment, La because people not bear, secretly gathered poor idle wanderers.
translations.idiomatic: Wu was harried by Zhu Mian's flower-and-stone levies; La secretly gathered the poor and idle.

sentences.zh: 宣和二年十月，起為亂，自號聖公，建元永樂，置官吏將帥，以巾飾為別，自紅巾而上凡 六等。

translations.literal: Xuanhe second year tenth month, rose as rebellion, self title Sacred Duke, established era Yongle, set officials generals, by headcloth ornament as distinction, from red headcloth upward altogether six grades.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of Xuanhe 2 he rebelled as the Sacred Duke, era Yongle, with ranks marked by headcloths—six grades from red upward.

sentences.zh: 無弓矢、介胄，唯以鬼神詭秘事相扇訹，焚室廬，掠金帛子女，誘脅良民為兵。

translations.literal: Without bow arrow, armor, only by ghost spirit deceit secret affairs mutually incite, burned houses, plundered gold silk women children, enticed coerced good people as soldiers.
translations.idiomatic: Without bows or armor they used occult rites, burned homes, plundered wealth and women, and coerced civilians into service.

sentences.zh: 人安於太平，不識兵革，聞金鼓聲即斂手聽命，不旬日聚眾至數萬，破殺將官 蔡遵於息坑。

translations.literal: People secure in great peace, not know weapons armor, heard gold drum sound then folded hands listen command, not ten days gathered crowd to tens of thousands, broke killed general officer Cai Zun at Xi pit.
translations.idiomatic: Unused to war, they obeyed at drumbeat; within ten days tens of thousands gathered and General Cai Zun was killed at Xi pit.

sentences.zh: 十一月陷青溪，十二月陷睦、歙二州。

translations.literal: Eleventh month fell Qingxi, twelfth month fell Mu, She two prefectures.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month Qingxi fell; in the twelfth, Mu and She.

sentences.zh: 南陷衢，殺郡守彭汝方；

translations.literal: South fell Qu, killed prefect Peng Rufang;
translations.idiomatic: Southward they took Qu and killed Prefect Peng Rufang;

sentences.zh: 北掠新城、桐廬、富陽諸縣，進逼杭州。

translations.literal: North plundered Xincheng, Tonglu, Fuyang various counties, advanced pressed Hangzhou.
translations.idiomatic: northward they raided Xincheng, Tonglu, and Fuyang and pressed Hangzhou.

sentences.zh: 郡守棄城走，州即陷，殺製置使陳建、廉訪使 趙約，縱火六日，死者不可計。

translations.literal: Prefect abandoned city fled, prefecture immediately fell, killed commissioner Chen Jian, investigation envoy Zhao Yue, set fire six days, dead are countless.
translations.idiomatic: The prefect fled; Hangzhou fell; Commissioner Chen Jian and Investigation Envoy Zhao Yue were killed; fire raged six days with countless dead.

sentences.zh: 凡得官吏，必斷臠支體，探其肺腸，或熬以膏油，叢鏑亂射，備盡楚毒，以償怨心。

translations.literal: Whenever obtained officials, must cut flesh limbs, probe their lung intestines, or boil with ointment oil, clustered arrows random shoot, fully prepared Chu tortures, to repay resentful heart.
translations.idiomatic: Captured officials were dismembered, disemboweled, boiled in oil, or shot in volleys—Chu tortures to repay hatred.

sentences.zh: 警奏至京師，王黼匿不以聞，於是凶焰日熾。

translations.literal: Alarm memorial reached capital, Wang Fu concealed not by report, thereupon fierce flame daily blaze.
translations.idiomatic: Alarms reached the capital but Wang Fu hid them, and the rebellion blazed hotter.

sentences.zh: 蘭溪靈山賊朱言吳邦、剡縣仇道人、仙居呂師囊、方岩山陳十四、蘇州石生、歸安陸行兒皆合黨應之，東南大震。

translations.literal: Lanxi Lingshan bandit Zhu Yan Wubang, Shan county Qiu Daoren, Xianju Lü Shinang, Fangyan mountain Chen Fourteen, Suzhou Shi Sheng, Gui'an Lu Xing'er all joined faction responded, southeast greatly shaken.
translations.idiomatic: Zhu Yan, Wubang, Qiu Daoren, Lü Shinang, Chen Fourteen, Shi Sheng, and Lu Xing'er all rose in league—the southeast shook.

sentences.zh: 發運使陳亨伯請調京畿兵及鼎、澧槍牌手兼程以來，使不至滋蔓。

translations.literal: Transport commissioner Chen Hengbo requested transfer capital region troops and Ding, Li spear shield hands expedite come, make not reach spread vine.
translations.idiomatic: Transport commissioner Chen Hengbo asked for capital troops and Ding-Li musketeers to hurry east lest the revolt spread.

sentences.zh: 徽宗始大驚，亟遣童貫、譚稹為宣撫製置使，率禁旅及秦、晉蕃漢兵十五萬以東，且諭貫使作詔 罷應奉局。

translations.literal: Huizong first greatly alarmed, urgently sent Tong Guan, Tan Zhen as pacification commissioners, led forbidden brigade and Qin, Jin barbarian Han troops hundred fifty thousand east, and instructed Guan make edict abolish Tribute Bureau.
translations.idiomatic: Huizong was alarmed and sent Tong Guan and Tan Zhen east with a hundred fifty thousand troops, ordering Guan to abolish the Tribute Bureau by edict.

sentences.zh: 三年正月，臘將方七佛引眾六萬攻秀州，統軍王子武乘城固守，已而大軍至，合擊賊，斬首九千，築京觀五，賊還據杭。

translations.literal: Third year first month, La will Fang Qifo led crowd sixty thousand attack Xiuzhou, commander Wang Ziwu by city firmly guard, already afterward great army arrived, combined struck bandits, beheaded nine thousand, built capital mounds five, bandits returned held Hang.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of year 3 Fang Qifo led sixty thousand against Xiuzhou; Wang Ziwu held the wall until the main army came, slew nine thousand, built five victory mounds, and the rebels retreated to Hangzhou.

sentences.zh: 二月，貫、稹前鋒至清河堰，水 陸並進，臘復焚官舍、府庫、民居，乃宵遁。

translations.literal: Second month, Guan, Zhen vanguard reached Qinghe weir, water land together advance, La again burned official quarters, treasuries, civilian houses, then night fled.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month the vanguard reached Qinghe weir by land and water; La burned government buildings and fled by night.

sentences.zh: 諸將劉延慶、王稟、王渙、楊惟忠、辛興宗相繼至，盡復所失城。

translations.literal: Generals Liu Yanqing, Wang Bin, Wang Huan, Yang Weizhong, Xin Xingzong successively arrived, all recovered lost cities.
translations.idiomatic: Liu Yanqing, Wang Bin, Wang Huan, Yang Weizhong, and Xin Xingzong arrived in turn and recovered the lost cities.

sentences.zh: 四月，生擒臘及妻邵、子毫二太子、偽相方肥等五十 二人於梓桐石穴中，殺賊七萬。

translations.literal: Fourth month, alive captured La and wife Shao, sons Hao two crown princes, false chief Fang Fei and others fifty-two men in Zitong stone cave, killed bandits seventy thousand.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month La, his wife Shao, sons Hao, false minister Fang Fei, and fifty-two others were taken alive in a Zitong cave; seventy thousand rebels were killed.

sentences.zh: 四年三月，餘黨悉平。

translations.literal: Fourth year third month, remnant factions all pacified.
translations.idiomatic: By the third month of year 4 the remnants were pacified.

sentences.zh: 進貫太師，徙國楚。

translations.literal: Advanced Guan Grand Preceptor, moved state Chu.
translations.idiomatic: Guan was made Grand Preceptor and enfeoffed in Chu.

sentences.zh: 臘之起，破六州五十二縣，戕平民二百萬，所掠婦女自賊峒逃出，倮而縊於林中者，由湯岩、椔嶺八十五里間，九村山谷相望。

translations.literal: La's rising, broke six prefectures fifty-two counties, killed common people two million, plundered women from bandit strongholds escaped, naked yet hanged in forest ones, from Tangyan, Zongling eighty-five li between, nine villages valleys mutually face.
translations.idiomatic: La had ravaged six prefectures and fifty-two counties, slain two million civilians; women who fled the strongholds were found naked and hanged for eighty-five li across nine valleys.

sentences.zh: 王師自出至凱旋，四百五十日。

translations.literal: Royal army from exit to triumph return, four hundred fifty days.
translations.idiomatic: The imperial campaign lasted four hundred fifty days from departure to triumph.

sentences.zh: 臘雖平，而北伐之役遂起。

translations.literal: La though pacified, yet north campaign affair then arose.
translations.idiomatic: Though La was crushed, the northern campaign followed.

sentences.zh: 既而以復燕山功，詔解節鉞為真三公，加封徐、豫兩國。

translations.literal: Already afterward by recover Yanshan merit, edict release military authority as true three dukes, added enfeoff Xu, Yu two states.
translations.idiomatic: For recovering Yanshan he was made a true Three Dukes and enfeoffed in Xu and Yu.

sentences.zh: 越兩月，命致仕，而代以譚稹。

translations.literal: Crossing two months, ordered retire office, yet replaced by Tan Zhen.
translations.idiomatic: Two months later he was ordered to retire, replaced by Tan Zhen.

sentences.zh: 明年復起，領樞密院，宣撫河北、燕山。

translations.literal: Next year again rose, led Privy Council, pacified Hebei, Yanshan.
translations.idiomatic: The next year he returned to lead the Privy Council and pacify Hebei and Yanshan.

sentences.zh: 宣和七年，詔用神宗遺訓，能復全燕之境者胙本邦，疏王爵，遂封廣陽郡王。

translations.literal: Xuanhe seventh year, edict used Shenzong testamentary instruction, able recover full Yan territory ones enfeoff native state, bestow king rank, then enfeoffed Guangyang commandery prince.
translations.idiomatic: In Xuanhe 7 Shenzong's testament promised enfeoffment to whoever recovered all Yan; Guan was made Prince of Guangyang.

sentences.zh: 是年，粘罕南侵，貫在太原，遣馬擴、辛興宗往聘以嚐金，金人以納張覺為責，且遣使告興兵，貫厚禮之，謂曰：“如此大事，何不素告我？”

translations.literal: That year, Nianhan south invaded, Guan at Taiyuan, sent Ma Kuo, Xin Xingzong go envoy to taste gold, Jin people by receiving Zhang Jue as blame, and sent envoy announce raise troops, Guan thickly treated them, said: “Such great affair, why not always tell me?”
translations.idiomatic: That year Nianhan invaded south; Guan was at Taiyuan and sent Ma Kuo and Xin Xingzong to negotiate; the Jin blamed the reception of Zhang Jue and announced war; Guan entertained them lavishly and said, “Why was I not told of this great matter?”

sentences.zh: 使者勸貫速割兩河 以謝，貫氣褫不能應，謀遁歸。

translations.literal: Envoy urged Guan quickly cede two He to apologize, Guan spirit drained could not respond, plotted flee return.
translations.idiomatic: The envoy urged him to cede the Two He to apologize; Guan was cowed speechless and plotted flight.

sentences.zh: 太原守張孝純誚之曰：“金人渝盟，王當令天下兵悉力枝梧，今委之而去，是棄河東與敵也。

translations.literal: Taiyuan guard Zhang Xiaochun reproached him said: “Jin people violated alliance, prince ought make under-heaven troops all strength branch support, now entrust it and leave, is abandon Hedong to enemy.
translations.idiomatic: Taiyuan defender Zhang Xiaochun reproached him: “The Jin broke the treaty—you should rally the empire; to leave is to abandon Hedong to the enemy.”

sentences.zh: 河東入敵手，奈河北乎？”

translations.literal: Hedong enters enemy hand, what of Hebei?”
translations.idiomatic: If Hedong falls, what of Hebei?”

sentences.zh: 貫怒叱之 曰：“貫受命宣撫，非守土也。

translations.literal: Guan angrily shouted him said: “Guan received mandate pacify, not guard land.
translations.idiomatic: Guan shouted back: “I am a pacification commissioner, not a territorial defender.”

sentences.zh: 君必欲留貫，置帥何為？”

translations.literal: You must wish detain Guan, place commander for what?
translations.idiomatic: If you must keep me here, why appoint a commander?”

sentences.zh: 孝純拊掌歎曰：“平生童太師作幾許威望，及臨事乃蓄縮畏懾，奉頭鼠竄，何面目復見天子乎？”

translations.literal: Xiaochun clapped palms sighed said: “All life Grand Preceptor Tong made how much prestige, when facing affair then stored shrink fear dread, offer head rat flee, what face again see Son of Heaven?
translations.idiomatic: Xiaochun clapped his hands and sighed: “All your life you built such prestige—yet in crisis you scurry like a rat—how can you face the Son of Heaven?”

sentences.zh: 貫奔入都，欽宗已受禪，下詔親征，以貫為東京留守，貫不受命而奉上皇南巡。

translations.literal: Guan fled enter capital, Qinzong already received abdication, issued edict personally campaign, by Guan as Eastern Capital garrison commander, Guan not receive order yet presented previous emperor south tour.
translations.idiomatic: Guan fled to the capital; Qinzong had succeeded and ordered a personal campaign, making Guan Eastern Capital commander; Guan refused and escorted the retired emperor south.

sentences.zh: 貫在西邊募長大少年號勝捷軍，幾萬人，以為親軍，環列第舍，至是擁之自隨。

translations.literal: Guan at western border recruited tall large youths called Victory Swift Army, nearly ten thousand men, as personal army, ringed lined mansions, to this embraced them self follow.
translations.idiomatic: On the frontier he had raised the Victory Swift Army of nearly ten thousand tall youths as his personal guard; now he took them with him.

sentences.zh: 上 皇過浮橋，衛士攀望號慟，貫唯恐行不速，使親軍射之，中矢而踣者百餘人，道路流涕，於是諫官、御史與國人議者蜂起。

translations.literal: Previous emperor passed floating bridge, guards climbed look wailed, Guan fearing travel not fast, made personal army shoot them, hit arrow and fall ones hundred-odd, road shed tears, thereupon remonstrance officials, censors with country people discussers swarmed rise.
translations.idiomatic: As the retired emperor crossed the floating bridge guards wept and clung to him; Guan had his guard shoot them down—more than a hundred—and remonstrators and the public erupted.

sentences.zh: 初貶左衛上將軍，連謫昭化軍節度副使， 竄之英州、吉陽軍。

translations.literal: First demoted Left Guard upper general, successively demoted Zhaohua Army military commissioner deputy envoy, banished to Yingzhou, Jiyang Army.
translations.idiomatic: He was first demoted to Left Guard upper general, then Zhaohua deputy commissioner, then banished to Ying and Jiyang.

sentences.zh: 行未至，詔數其十大罪，命監察御史張澂跡其所至，蒞斬之，及於南雄。

translations.literal: Journey not yet arrived, edict counted his ten great crimes, ordered investigating censor Zhang Cheng trace his where reached, oversee execute him, reaching Nanxiong.
translations.idiomatic: Before he arrived an edict listed ten crimes and sent censor Zhang Cheng to track and execute him at Nanxiong.

sentences.zh: 既誅，函首赴闕，梟於都市。

translations.literal: Already executed, boxed head sent court, displayed at capital market.
translations.idiomatic: After execution his head was boxed and displayed in the capital market.

sentences.zh: 貫握兵二十年，權傾一時， 奔走期會過於製敕。

translations.literal: Guan grasped troops twenty years, power leaned one generation, rush appointments exceeded regulations edicts.
translations.idiomatic: Guan held the army twenty years with power over the age; his summons outran imperial regulations.

sentences.zh: 嚐有論其過者，詔方劭往察，劭一動一息，貫悉偵得之，先密以白，且陷以他事，劭反得罪，逐死。

translations.literal: Once had discuss his faults ones, edict Fang Shao go inspect, Shao one move one breath, Guan all spied obtained, beforehand secretly report, and framed with other affairs, Shao instead offended, expelled died.
translations.idiomatic: When Fang Shao was sent to investigate him, Guan spied on his every move, denounced him first on other charges, and Shao was ruined and died in exile.

sentences.zh: 貫狀魁梧，偉觀視，頤下生須十數，皮骨勁 如鐵，不類閹人。

translations.literal: Guan form lofty, great appearance look, chin below grew beard ten-odd, skin bone strong like iron, not resemble eunuch.
translations.idiomatic: Guan was tall and imposing, with a dozen whiskers under his chin and iron-hard frame—hardly like a eunuch.

sentences.zh: 有度量，能疏財。

translations.literal: Had measure, able disperse wealth.
translations.idiomatic: He had breadth and gave freely.

sentences.zh: 後宮自妃嬪以下皆獻餉結內，左右婦寺譽言日聞。

translations.literal: Rear palace from consorts below all presented gifts connect inside, left-right women attendants praise words daily heard.
translations.idiomatic: From consorts down the harem sent gifts to court him; palace women daily praised him.

sentences.zh: 寵煽翕赫，庭戶雜遝成市，嶽牧、輔弼多出其門，廝養、仆圉官諸使者至數百 輩。

translations.literal: Favor blaze brilliantly, courtyard doors mixed crowded became market, mountain governors, chief assistants mostly exited his gate, stable boys, groom officials various envoys reached several hundred bands.
translations.idiomatic: His favor blazed; his courtyard was a market; governors and ministers came from his gate; hundreds served as grooms and envoys.

sentences.zh: 窮奸稔禍，流毒四海，雖菹醢不償責也。

translations.literal: Exhausted treachery ripe disaster, flowed poison four seas, though mince meat not repay debt.
translations.idiomatic: His treachery poisoned the realm—execution could not repay the debt.

sentences.zh: 梁師成

translations.literal: Liang Shicheng
translations.idiomatic: Liang Shicheng

sentences.zh: 梁師成，字守道，慧黠習文法，稍知書。

translations.literal: Liang Shicheng, style Shoudao, clever crafty studied document law, slightly knew books.
translations.idiomatic: Liang Shicheng, courtesy name Shoudao, was clever, knew document law, and could read a little.

sentences.zh: 初隸賈詳書藝局，詳死，得領睿思殿文字外庫，主出外傳道上 旨。

translations.literal: He first served Jia Xiang's calligraphy bureau; after Xiang's death he headed the Ruisi Hall outer treasury and relayed edicts on the road.
translations.idiomatic: He first served Jia Xiang's calligraphy bureau; after Xiang's death he headed the Ruisi Hall outer treasury and relayed edicts on the road.

sentences.zh: 政和間，得君貴幸，至竄名進士籍中，積遷晉州觀察使、興德軍留後。

translations.literal: Zhenghe between, obtained ruler precious favor, to falsify name in advanced scholar register, accumulated moved Jinzhou observation envoy, Xingde Army acting governor.
translations.idiomatic: In Zhenghe he won the emperor's favor, slipped his name into the jinshi rolls, and rose to observation envoy of Jinzhou and acting governor of Xingde.

sentences.zh: 建明堂，為都監，既成，拜節度使、加中太一、神霄宮使。

translations.literal: Built Bright Hall, was all supervisor, already completed, bestowed military commissioner, added Central Great One, Divine Empyrean palace envoy.
translations.idiomatic: Overseeing the Bright Hall's construction, he was made military commissioner and envoy of the Central Great One and Divine Empyrean palaces when it was done.

sentences.zh: 曆護國、鎮東、河東三節度， 至檢校太傅，遂拜太尉、開府儀同三司，換節淮南。

translations.literal: Successively Huguo, Zhendong, Hedong three military commissions, to acting grand tutor, then bestowed Grand Commandant, open-fu equal three offices, exchanged commission Huainan.
translations.idiomatic: He held three military commissions, rose to acting grand tutor, then Grand Commandant and Open-fu Equal to the Three Offices, and exchanged to Huainan.

sentences.zh: 時中外泰寧，徽宗留意禮文符瑞之事，師成善逢迎，希恩寵。

translations.literal: At time inside outside great peace, Huizong paid attention ritual documents auspicious omens affairs, Shicheng good ingratiate meet, hope grace favor.
translations.idiomatic: The realm was at peace and Huizong cared for ritual and omens; Shicheng flattered him for favor.

sentences.zh: 帝本以隸人畜之，命入處殿中，凡禦 書號令皆出其手，多擇善書吏習仿帝書，雜詔旨以出，外廷莫能辨。

translations.literal: Emperor originally by slave livestock kept him, ordered enter dwell palace hall, every imperial writing edicts all exited his hand, many selected good writing clerks study imitate emperor writing, mixed edicts to exit, outer court could not distinguish.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor kept him as a household slave yet put him in the hall; imperial writings came from his hand; clerks imitated the emperor's script and mixed edicts the outer court could not tell.

sentences.zh: 師成實不能文，而高自標榜，自言蘇軾出子。

translations.literal: Shicheng actually could not write, yet high self advertise, self said born of Su Shi.
translations.idiomatic: Shicheng could not really write yet boasted that he was Su Shi's son.

sentences.zh: 是時，天下禁誦軾文，其尺牘在人間者皆毀去，師 成訴於帝曰：“先臣何罪？”

translations.literal: At that time, under-heaven forbidden recite Shi writings, his letters in people's midst all destroyed go, Shicheng complained to emperor said: “Former subject what crime?”
translations.idiomatic: Su Shi's works were banned and his letters destroyed; Shicheng pleaded to the emperor, “What crime did my forebear commit?”

sentences.zh: 自是，軾之文乃稍出。

translations.literal: From this, Shi's writings then slightly emerged.
translations.idiomatic: From then Su Shi's writings slowly reappeared.

sentences.zh: 以翰墨為己任，四方俊秀名士必招致門下，往往遭點汙。

translations.literal: By brush ink as self duty, four directions outstanding scholars must summon attract under gate, often suffered spot stain.
translations.idiomatic: He made brush and ink his charge, summoned talented men, and often stained them.

sentences.zh: 多置書畫卷軸於外舍，邀賓客縱觀，得其題識合意者， 輒密加汲引，執政、侍從可階而升。

translations.literal: He displayed paintings for guests; those whose inscriptions pleased him were secretly promoted to ministerial posts.
translations.idiomatic: He displayed paintings for guests; those whose inscriptions pleased him were secretly promoted to ministerial posts.

sentences.zh: 王黼父事之，雖蔡京父子亦諂附焉，都人目為“隱相”，所領職局至數十百。

translations.literal: Wang Fu father served him, though Cai Jing father-son also flatter attached, capital people called “hidden chief minister”, offices led reached tens of hundreds.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Fu treated him as a father; even the Cai Jings fawned on him; the capital called him the hidden chief minister, with hundreds of offices.

sentences.zh: 黼造伐燕議，師成始猶依違，卒乃讚 決，又薦譚稹為宣撫。

translations.literal: Fu created attack Yan plan, Shicheng beginning still hesitate, finally then praise decide, again recommended Tan Zhen as pacification.
translations.idiomatic: When Fu proposed attacking Yan Shicheng hesitated then approved and recommended Tan Zhen as pacifier.

sentences.zh: 燕山平，策勳進少保。

translations.literal: Yanshan pacified, recorded merit advanced junior guardian.
translations.idiomatic: When Yanshan was pacified he was made junior guardian for merit.

sentences.zh: 益通賄謝，人士入錢數百萬，以獻頌上書為名，令赴廷試，唱第之日，侍於帝前，囁嚅升降。

translations.literal: More connected bribes thanks, scholars enter money several million, by present praise memorial name, ordered attend palace examination, announce rank day, attended before emperor, murmur rise fall.
translations.idiomatic: He took millions in bribes, had donors present praise memorials and sit the palace exam while he murmured beside the emperor on ranking day.

sentences.zh: 其小吏儲宏亦豫科甲，而 執廝養之役如初。

translations.literal: His petty clerk Chu Hong also pre-entered jinshi class, yet performed stable groom duty as beginning.
translations.idiomatic: His clerk Chu Hong also passed the jinshi yet still tended stables.

sentences.zh: 李彥括民田於京東、西，所至倨坐堂上，監司、郡守不敢抗禮。

translations.literal: Li Yan seized commoner fields at Jing east, west, where arrived arrogantly sat hall above, supervisors, prefects dared not resist ritual.
translations.idiomatic: Li Yan seized fields in the east; wherever he went he sat arrogantly in the hall while supervisors and prefects dared not stand on ceremony.

sentences.zh: 有言於帝，師成適在旁，抗聲曰：“王人雖微，序於諸侯之上，豈足為過？”

translations.literal: Had speech to emperor, Shicheng just at side, resisted voice said: “King's man though slight, order above feudal lords, how enough be fault?”
translations.idiomatic: When someone spoke to the emperor Shicheng cried aloud: “A king's man, though lowly, ranks above feudal lords—is that a fault?”

sentences.zh: 言者 懼而止。

translations.literal: Speaker feared and stopped.
translations.idiomatic: The speaker fell silent in fear.

sentences.zh: 師成貌若不能言，然陰賊險鷙，遇間即發。

translations.literal: Shicheng appearance as if could not speak, yet hidden treacherous dangerous fierce, meeting gap then erupt.
translations.idiomatic: Shicheng seemed unable to speak yet was secretly vicious and struck when chance came.

sentences.zh: 家居與黼鄰，帝幸黼第，見其交通狀，已怒，朱勔又以應奉與黼軋，因乘隙攻之。

translations.literal: Home dwelt with Fu neighbor, emperor visited Fu residence, saw their communication condition, already angry, Zhu Mian again by Tribute Bureau with Fu clash, thereby seized gap attack him.
translations.idiomatic: He lived beside Fu; the emperor saw their dealings at Fu's house and grew angry; Zhu Mian's clash with Fu gave a chance to attack.

sentences.zh: 帝罷黼相，師成 由是益絀。

translations.literal: Emperor dismissed Fu chief minister, Shicheng by this more diminished.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor dismissed Fu; Shicheng was thereby diminished.

sentences.zh: 鄆王楷寵盛，有動搖東宮意，師成能力保護。

translations.literal: Yun prince Kai favor flourishing, had shake Eastern Palace intent, Shicheng able strength protect.
translations.idiomatic: Prince Kai of Yun was favored to the Eastern Palace's peril; Shicheng protected the heir.

sentences.zh: 欽宗立，嬖臣多從上皇東下，師成以舊恩留京師。

translations.literal: Qinzong established, favored minions mostly followed previous emperor east down, Shicheng by old grace remained capital.
translations.idiomatic: When Qinzong ascended, favored minions followed the retired emperor east; Shicheng stayed at the capital on old favor.

sentences.zh: 於是太學生陳東、布衣張炳力疏其罪。

translations.literal: Thereupon academy student Chen Dong, commoner Zhang Bing forcefully memorialized his crimes.
translations.idiomatic: Then academy student Chen Dong and commoner Zhang Bing fiercely memorialized his crimes.

sentences.zh: 炳指之為李輔國， 且言宦官表裏相應，變恐不測。

translations.literal: Bing pointed him as Li Fuguo, and said eunuchs inside outside mutually respond, change fear not measure.
translations.idiomatic: Bing compared him to Li Fuguo and warned that inner and outer eunuchs in league could bring unpredictable ruin.

sentences.zh: 東復論其有異志，攘定策功，當正典刑。

translations.literal: Dong again discussed he has different intent, seized fix policy merit, ought correct canonical punishment.
translations.idiomatic: Chen Dong added that he harbored ulterior intent, had usurped merit in fixing the succession, and deserved statutory punishment.

sentences.zh: 帝迫於公議，猶未誦言逐之。

translations.literal: Emperor forced by public discussion, still not recite words expel him.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor, pressed by public opinion, still would not speak of expelling him.

sentences.zh: 師成疑之，寢食不離帝所，雖奏廁亦侍於外，久未有以發。

translations.literal: Shicheng suspected it, sleep eat not leave emperor's place, though memorial privy also attended outside, long not had means send forth.
translations.idiomatic: Shicheng grew suspicious and would not leave the emperor's side, even waiting outside the privy, finding no chance to act.

sentences.zh: 會 鄭望之使金營還，帝命師成及望之以宣和殿珠玉器玩復往。

translations.literal: Meeting Zheng Wangzhi sent Jin camp return, emperor ordered Shicheng and Wangzhi by Xuanhe Hall pearl jade vessels play again go.
translations.idiomatic: When Zheng Wangzhi returned from the Jin camp the emperor ordered Shicheng and Wangzhi to take Xuanhe Hall treasures to the Jin again.

sentences.zh: 先令望之詣中書諭宰相，至則留之，始詔暴其罪，責為彰化軍節度副使。

translations.literal: First ordered Wangzhi go notify central secretariat, arrived then detained him, beginning edict exposed his crimes, blamed as Zhanghua Army military commissioner deputy envoy.
translations.idiomatic: Wangzhi was first sent to inform the secretariat, then detained; an edict exposed Shicheng's crimes and demoted him to deputy commissioner of Zhanghua.

sentences.zh: 開封吏護至貶所，行次八角鎮， 縊殺之，以暴死聞，籍其家。

translations.literal: Kaifeng clerks escorted to demoted place, journey reached Bajiao town, strangled killed him, by sudden death reported, registered his household.
translations.idiomatic: Kaifeng officers escorted him toward exile; at Bajiao town he was strangled and reported as sudden death; his property was confiscated.

sentences.zh: 楊戩，少給事掖庭，主掌後苑，善測伺人主意。

translations.literal: Yang Jian, young attended Rear Palace, managed rear garden, good measured probed ruler intent.
translations.idiomatic: Yang Jian in youth served the rear palace, managed the rear garden, and was skilled at reading the emperor's wishes.

sentences.zh: 自崇寧後，日有寵，知入內內侍省。

translations.literal: From Chongning afterward, daily had favor, knew enter-inner inner attendant province.
translations.idiomatic: After Chongning he grew daily in favor and became superintendent of the Enter-the-Inner Inner Attendant Province.

sentences.zh: 立明堂，鑄鼎鼐、起大晟府、龍德宮，皆為提舉。

translations.literal: Established Bright Hall, cast tripod cauldrons, raised Great Splendor office, Dragon Virtue palace, all were supervised by him.
translations.idiomatic: He directed the Bright Hall, casting of tripods, the Great Splendor Music Office, and the Dragon Virtue Palace.

sentences.zh: 政和四年，拜彰化軍節度使，首建期門行幸事以固其權，勢與梁師成埒。

translations.literal: Zhenghe fourth year, bestowed Zhanghua Army military commissioner, first established Gate Guard travel fortune affair to solidify his power, power equal Liang Shicheng.
translations.idiomatic: In Zhenghe 4 he was made military commissioner of Zhanghua, invented imperial outings of the Gate Guard to fix his power, rivaling Liang Shicheng.

sentences.zh: 曆鎮安、清海、鎮東三鎮，由檢校少保至太傅，遂謀撼東宮。

translations.literal: Successively Zhen'an, Qinghai, Zhendong three commissions, from acting junior guardian to grand tutor, then plotted shake Eastern Palace.
translations.idiomatic: He held three military commissions, rose from acting junior guardian to grand tutor, and plotted against the heir.

sentences.zh: 有胥吏杜公才者獻策於戩，立法索民田契，自甲之乙，乙之丙，展轉究尋，至無可證，則度地所出，增立賦租。

translations.literal: Had clerk Du Gongcai presented plan to Jian, legislated seek people's field deeds, from A's B, B's C, turn investigate seek, to no proof, then measure land output, add establish tax rent.
translations.idiomatic: Clerk Du Gongcai proposed tracing land deeds from owner to owner until none could be proved, then taxing measured output.

sentences.zh: 始於汝州，浸淫於京東西、淮西北，括廢堤、棄 堰、荒山、退灘及大河淤流之處，皆勒民主佃。

translations.literal: Beginning at Ruzhou it spread across the east, northwest, and Huai region, seizing wasteland and river silt and forcing owners to tenant.
translations.idiomatic: Beginning at Ruzhou it spread across the east, northwest, and Huai region, seizing wasteland and river silt and forcing owners to tenant.

sentences.zh: 額一定後，雖衝蕩回復不可減，號為“西城所”。

translations.literal: Quota once fixed afterward, though flood scour return restore could not reduce, called “Western City office”.
translations.idiomatic: Once quotas were set they could not be reduced even if floods restored the land—the scheme was called the Western City office.

sentences.zh: 築山濼古钜野澤，綿亙數百里，濟、鄆數州，賴其蒲魚之利，立租 算船納直，犯者盜執之。

translations.literal: Built mountain marshes ancient Juye marsh, stretching several hundred li, Ji, Yun several prefectures, relied on its rush fish profit, established rent calculate boat pay straight, violators stolen seized.
translations.idiomatic: They diked the ancient Juye marsh for hundreds of li; boat tolls were levied and violators arrested.

sentences.zh: 一邑率於常賦外增租錢至十餘萬緡，水旱蠲稅，此不得免。

translations.literal: One district rate on top of regular tax added rent money to ten-odd ten-thousands strings, water drought exempt tax, this could not escape.
translations.idiomatic: Districts paid more than a hundred thousand strings above regular tax; drought exemptions did not apply.

sentences.zh: 擢公才為觀察使。

translations.literal: Promoted Gongcai as observation envoy.
translations.idiomatic: Gongcai was made observation envoy.

sentences.zh: 宣和三年，戩死，贈太師、吳國公，而李彥繼其職。

translations.literal: Xuanhe third year, Jian died, bestowed Grand Preceptor, Wu state duke, yet Li Yan succeeded his office.
translations.idiomatic: In Xuanhe 3 Jian died, was posthumously made Grand Preceptor and Duke of Wu; Li Yan succeeded him.

sentences.zh: 彥天資狠愎，密與王黼表裏，置局汝州，臨事愈劇。

translations.literal: Yan nature fierce obstinate, secretly with Wang Fu inside outside, set office Ruzhou, facing affairs more severe.
translations.idiomatic: Yan was fierce and colluded with Wang Fu, setting up an office at Ruzhou with harsher methods.

sentences.zh: 凡民間美田，使他人投牒告陳，皆指為天荒，雖執印券皆不省。

translations.literal: Whenever common people's fine fields, made others submit memorial report declare, all pointed as heaven wasteland, though holding seal deeds all not examined.
translations.idiomatic: Fine private fields were denounced as crown wasteland regardless of deeds.

sentences.zh: 魯山闔縣盡括為公田，焚民故券，使田主輸租 佃本業，訴者輒加威刑，致死者千萬。

translations.literal: Lushan whole county all seized as public field, burned people's old deeds, made field owners pay rent tenant original occupation, appealers then added harsh punishment, caused dead to tens of millions.
translations.idiomatic: Lushan county was entirely seized; old deeds were burned; owners paid rent as tenants; appellants were tortured to death by the millions.

sentences.zh: 公田既無二稅，轉運使亦不為奏除，悉均諸別州。

translations.literal: Public fields already without two taxes, transport commissioners also not for them memorialize remove, all averaged various other prefectures.
translations.idiomatic: Public fields paid no double tax yet transport commissioners did not seek relief; burdens were averaged to other prefectures.

sentences.zh: 京西提舉官及京東州縣吏劉寄、任輝彥、李士漁、王滸、毛孝立、王隨、江 惇、呂坯、錢棫、宋憲皆助彥為虐，如奴事主，民不勝忿痛。

translations.literal: Liu Ji, Ren Huiyan, Li Shiyu, Wang Hu, Mao Xiaoli, Wang Sui, Jiang Dun, Lü Pi, Qian Qi, and Song Xian helped Yan tyrannize the people like slaves to a master.
translations.idiomatic: Liu Ji, Ren Huiyan, Li Shiyu, Wang Hu, Mao Xiaoli, Wang Sui, Jiang Dun, Lü Pi, Qian Qi, and Song Xian helped Yan tyrannize the people like slaves to a master.

sentences.zh: 前執政冠帶操笏，迎謁馬首獻媚，花朝夕造請，賓客徑趍謁舍，不敢對之上馬，而彥處之自如。

translations.literal: Former chief ministers with belt girdle held tablets, met bowing at horse head presenting flattery, flower morning evening visited requesting, guests directly hurried visit lodge, dared not face above mount horse, yet Yan dwelt it self at ease.
translations.idiomatic: Former chief ministers with tablets bowed at his horse; guests cringed at his lodge while Yan remained at ease.

sentences.zh: 發物供奉，大抵類朱勔，凡竹數竿用一大車、牛驢數十頭，其數無極，皆責辦於民，經時閱月，無休息期。

translations.literal: Sent objects for imperial tribute, mostly like Zhu Mian, every bamboo several rods used one great cart, ox donkeys several tens head, its number without limit, all forced provide on people, through time months, without rest period.
translations.idiomatic: Tribute goods like Zhu Mian's required whole carts and dozens of animals per trifle, forced on the people without rest.

sentences.zh: 農不得之田，牛不得耕墾，殫財靡芻，力竭餓死，或自 縊轅軛間。

translations.literal: Farmers could not obtain fields, oxen could not plow reclaim, exhaust wealth waste fodder, strength exhausted starve die, or self hang between shaft yoke.
translations.idiomatic: Farmers lost fields, oxen could not plow, wealth was spent, strength failed, and many hanged themselves on cart shafts.

sentences.zh: 如龍鱗薜荔一本，輦致之費逾百萬。

translations.literal: Like dragon scale ivy one root, transport arrive cost exceeded million.
translations.idiomatic: A single dragon-scale ivy cost more than a million to deliver.

sentences.zh: 喜賞怒刑，禍福轉手，因之得美官者甚眾。

translations.literal: Joy reward anger punishment, disaster blessing turn hand, thereby obtained beautiful offices many.
translations.idiomatic: Reward and punishment turned on his whim and many won offices through him.

sentences.zh: 潁昌兵馬鈐轄範寥不為取竹，誣刊蘇軾詩文於石為十惡，朝廷察其捃摭， 亦令勒停。

translations.literal: Yingchang horse-all commander Fan Liao not for take bamboo, falsely carved Su Shi poetry text on stone as ten evils, court examined its fabricate gather, also ordered stop.
translations.idiomatic: Fan Liao of Yingchang refused bamboo; Yan forged Su Shi's verse on stone as ten crimes; the court saw the frame-up and ordered him stopped.

sentences.zh: 當時謂朱勔結怨於東南，李彥結怨於西北。

translations.literal: At that time said Zhu Mian formed resentment in southeast, Li Yan formed resentment in northwest.
translations.idiomatic: People said Zhu Mian bred resentment in the southeast and Li Yan in the northwest.

sentences.zh: 靖康初，詔追戩所贈官爵，彥削官賜死，籍其家；

translations.literal: Jingkang beginning, edict pursue Jian's bestowed offices ranks, Yan cut office bestowed death, registered his household;
translations.idiomatic: At the beginning of Jingkang Jian's posthumous honors were revoked; Yan was stripped and executed and his household confiscated;

sentences.zh: 劉寄以下十人皆停廢；

translations.literal: Liu Ji below ten men all stopped abolished;
translations.idiomatic: Liu Ji and the other ten were all dismissed;

sentences.zh: 復範寥官。

translations.literal: Restored Fan Liao office.
translations.idiomatic: Fan Liao's office was restored.
